answer: Operator, 2026-11-05: isolated for v0.1, and worth coming back to. Ship zmx in the jail so pi-zmx works inside it; say in the README that jailed sessions are not visible to the host.
body: Per c-devjail, a jailed session dies with the jail. Inferred, not tested: its sockets are also a separate world, so host zp cannot see it. Sharing a socket directory would give the jail write access to host sessions and still would not make jailed sessions outlive it. Recommendation for v0.1: keep the jail isolated, ship zmx in the jail so pi-zmx works inside it, and say so in the README. Host pi gets the full path.
title: Should jailed agents' sessions be visible on the host?
